facts.text: MultiRobotGazeboConnection creates /gazebo/unpause_physics and /gazebo/pause_physics std_srvs/Empty service proxies.
pauseSim waits for /gazebo/pause_physics and calls it; unpauseSim does the same for /gazebo/unpause_physics.
MultiRobotGazeboEnv.step unpauses physics, calls _set_action, then pauses physics before reading observations.
MultiRobotGazeboEnv._reset_sim calls pauseSim, _set_init_gazebo_pose, unpauseSim, _check_all_systems_ready and _set_init_ros in that order.
ReferSystem advertises the relative start_game service and a latched rm_simulator/ReferSystemInfo publisher with queue size 1 on the relative refer_system_info topic.
isGameStart is a global flag that starts false.
ReferSystem advertises a geometry_msgs/Twist publisher on /jackal0/cmd_vel to /jackal3/cmd_vel and subscribes to each robot's /jackalN/cmd_vel_acc topic.
cmdCallback0 republishes the twist of each roborts_msgs/TwistAccel message through cmd_pub[0] while robotMove[0] is 1.
startGame stores req.start in isGameStart, sets res.received = true, and returns true; initialize() runs only when the requested start is true.
The referee main loop runs at 120 Hz and calls game_spin only while isGameStart is true.
game_spin ends by publishing refer_system_msg through state_pub.

The ReferSystemInfo message defines robotHealth[4], remain_bullet[4], robotShoot[4], robotShootDebuffTime[4], robotMove[4], robotMoveDebuffTime[4], cellState[6], cellStateNumber[6], cellX[6], cellY[6], robotPose[4] and gameTime.
GameState.srv carries bool start in the request and bool received in the response.
The turret controller subscribes to the relative turret_position std_msgs/Float32 topic and copies msg->data into the first JointTrajectory position for front_camera_pivot_joint.
The front_camera_pivot_joint URDF limit is lower -1.5707 and upper 1.5707 rad with velocity 10 and effort 2.
The mecanum drive controller subscribes to the relative cmd_vel geometry_msgs/Twist topic.
control.launch (namespace argument ns, default jackal0) spawns ridgeback_velocity_controller and relays the namespace's cmd_vel topic to ridgeback_velocity_controller/cmd_vel with topic_tools relay.
one_ridgeback.launch includes control.launch and teleop.launch for the robot namespace and starts the RoboRTS local planner with /cmd_vel_acc remapped to the namespace's cmd_vel_acc.
The mecanum drive controller brakes the last command when the cmd_vel age exceeds cmd_vel_timeout_ and then applies the configured velocity and acceleration limiters.
The ridgeback controller config sets cmd_vel_timeout 0.25 s and enables linear x, linear y and angular z velocity and acceleration limits.
The mecanum drive controller loads min_velocity and min_acceleration as the negative of the configured maximum when the parameters are absent.
The README documents /jackal0/turret_position as an angle in radians and /start_game as a service that is not used currently.
The training environment registers AiChallengeEnv-v1 for MultiAgentAiChallengeEnv, which inherits MultiRobotGazeboEnv.
MultiAgentAiChallengeEnv._get_obs is a pass, _compute_reward returns 0 and _is_done returns False; the gym registration is a scaffold, not a completed observation/step contract.

determinism.notes: Event-driven recording fake with no physics step or pacing; placeholder referee, turret and base samples do not establish trajectory or state-hash replay

gaps: the fake is a ROS-free recording transport: it answers the declared pause, unpause, start_game, referee, turret and cmd_vel endpoints and runs no Gazebo physics, controllers, robot dynamics, sensors or wall-clock loop
the referee, turret and base values are placeholders; a live run must receive them from the operator's simulator and ROS nodes

the /gazebo/pause_physics and /gazebo/unpause_physics implementations are in gazebo_ros, outside the pinned clone; the clone proves the client endpoints and their use in the openai_ros step/reset lifecycle, not the callback body

pausing physics freezes the Gazebo world but does not terminate the referee node, its game loop or the controllers; unpausing can resume motion from retained controller state, and any other client's /gazebo/unpause_physics call, including MultiRobotGazeboEnv.step and _reset_sim of a running openai_ros training script, undoes the stop

/jackal0/cmd_vel reaches ridgeback_velocity_controller/cmd_vel through the topic_tools relay of control.launch; in the shipped launch the referee node also publishes there, forwarding the RoboRTS local planner's /jackal0/cmd_vel_acc while robotMove[0] is 1, so this package's publications share the topic with other publishers
a cmd_vel publication is transmission-only; the mecanum controller's 0.25 s stale-command brake is a controller timeout, not an acknowledged stop
a turret_position publication is transmission-only; the turret controller republishes a JointTrajectory and neither the driver nor the source confirms that the joint reached the requested angle

isGameStart starts false and game_spin publishes the latched /refer_system_info topic only while it is true: before a /start_game true no sample exists and a live read times out, and after start:false a new subscription receives the last latched sample, which is stale; the fake answers regardless and marks no game state

with /use_sim_time true (ridgeback_robots.launch passes use_sim_time true to gazebo_ros's empty_world.launch) the referee loop's ros::Rate sleeps on simulated time, so while physics is paused it neither services /start_game nor publishes: a start_game call made then can time out (unknown outcome) and a read returns the last latched sample
the AiChallengeEnv-v1 gym registration is a scaffold: _get_obs returns None, _compute_reward returns 0 and _is_done returns False; this package does not claim an environment-step contract

NOT COVERED: the ReferSystemInfo header, cellState and debuff-time fields; the /jackal0/shoot, /jackal0/debuff, /jackal0/cmd_vel_acc, /jackal0/obstacle_filtered, camera, laser and TF surfaces; the multi-robot jackal1..3 namespaces

safe_state.description: Simulated physics is paused through the acknowledged /gazebo/pause_physics service, so the Gazebo world stops stepping until any client calls /gazebo/unpause_physics (an openai_ros environment step does); the referee node, the planners and their retained commands are not stopped.
